category_title: Noncompliant students who misbehave due to boredom or environmental distractions
scenario_title: Disruptive behavior during long test-preparation activity
minimal_context: Melinda is participating in a 45-minute Power Play test-preparation activity in a classroom where other students are present.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Alright everyone, it is time for our 45-minute Power Play test-preparation activity. Please open your materials and begin working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Laughs loudly with a peer) Sometimes we talk in class and I can't concentrate. If I hear students talking I start talking too.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Melinda, please lower your voice and get back to your assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: There is a lot of talking in here. When my friends talk to me, I don't want to be rude, so I talk back to them. It is easier for me to concentrate in other classes.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: You just need to focus on the test prep right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Stands up and slams the classroom door) I get mad during Power Play! I was bored. I'm going to the bathroom, I talk a lot when I go there anyway.
